notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, there is no hardware backend, and no hardware run is claimed. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver matched the interface and was used unchanged (no card deviation). The package serves the registered SoArm-v0 environment of gym_soarm.env:SoArmAlohaEnv. The clone cannot be imported here: it needs gymnasium, numpy, dm-control and MuJoCo (pyproject.toml:21-26), and gym_soarm/tasks/sim.py imports torch, lerobot and a missing .reward_wrapper module (sim.py:1-16); therefore the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The fake backend is a pure Python kinematic stand-in, so the fidelity contract is F0, not the upstream MuJoCo F1. NOT COVERED: the camera image arrays. The real environment renders 480x640x3 per camera (sim.py:188-192); the fake returns 2x2x3 placeholder frames of the same rank, named in the fidelity gaps. The scalar and state functions are covered: 6 joint positions (agent_pos), reward, terminated, truncated, tick and world state. Also not modelled by the fake: contacts, object motion and grasping (the cube stays where reset placed it, so termination occurs only when a reset places it on the goal plate), the stacking task, wall-clock pacing, and snapshots. The five warnings are the expected Gymnasium family warnings, not failures: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only stores the seed for the next reset, so no native call is made) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.values, seed twice). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Risk is R0 because the device is a simulated world (world.sim) whose served effects are simulation.advance through the cap.world.* classes, whose catalogue class floor is R0; no physical effect and no hardware e-stop path exist, so the e-stop is the runtime software latch described in safe_state. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
